acceptanceCriteria: 3 hosted PR runs with max shard at most 17 min.
A REUSE push still decides REUSE.
Partition identity and qualification rows re-pinned with evidence.
body: Found 2026-10-10 by the CI audit (report /private/tmp/claude-501/gotmp/ci-audit.md; 60 ci.yml runs; main run 38055182050). PR wall median 39.8 min, critical path always go-product-shard 0. After the internal/tasks/store speedup and T1, 8 shards would take PR wall from ~19-21 to ~15.5-16.5 min (cmd/corvint ~765s becomes the floor) for ~5 extra runner-min per run. REUSE_SHARDS must change in the same commit or main-push reuse silently falls back to full. Shard count is part of the AFP-V0-014 frozen identity: coordinate with V1-0811/V1-0039 qualification rows. Related V1-0617.
title: ci: raise go-product shard count to 8 after the store test fix, re-pinning REUSE_SHARDS and the partition identity
